Transparent signature maker

A signature on plain paper is an ideal subject for BG Studio: dark ink on a light, even background. Because everything happens in your browser, your signature is never uploaded to a server.

How to make a transparent signature

  1. Sign with a dark pen on plain white paper and take a bright, even photo (or scan it).
  2. Add the photo to BG Studio and click Remove background.
  3. If paper shadows remain, raise Tolerance. If thin strokes start to fade, lower it.
  4. Choose PNG so the signature stays transparent, then click Convert & download.

Tips for a clean signature

  • Good lighting matters most. Avoid shadows across the paper.
  • A thicker dark pen gives cleaner edges.
  • Keep the file as PNG so the signature stays transparent when placed over a document.
  • Only use your own signature, and keep the original file private.

Frequently asked questions

Is my signature uploaded anywhere?

No. It is processed in your browser and never leaves your device, which matters for something this personal.

Which format should I save a signature in?

PNG. It keeps the paper transparent so the signature can sit on any document. Use JPG only if a form refuses PNG; transparent areas then become the fill color you choose.

Why does my signature look jagged?

Use a higher-resolution photo and raise Edge softness to 2 or 3.
